summary: Follow-up review of the five round-1 findings at 0c9e57ef2. All five are remedied as described in responses.md and are closed. S4-R1-01: README now has a dedicated paragraph stating that all nine MPI logs retain UCX unmatched tag-receive warnings at shutdown after report save and PASS, that the active PML was UCX and '--mca btl self,vader' did not select or constrain it, that all nine launchers exited zero, and that no MPI/psana shutdown fix is claimed; mpi_transport_probe.log shows 'selected ucx best priority 51' on both ranks, corroborating the PML claim. S4-R1-02: README binds all nine MPI cases to working-tree pilot.json SHA256 c5abc67a… (matching serial_summary.json line 392 and provenance.json line 21) and explicitly defers in-report reference-hash recording to a future driver revision; historical reports are untouched (hashes unchanged in provenance.json). S4-R1-03: status.json now reads 'superseded by archived pilot.json: eight JF types and six calibrated samples pass'. S4-R1-04: README records the reviewer cross-check, and schedule_crosscheck.json shows expected==actual for the three BeginStep timestamps, which match serial_summary.json steps and timestamp_schedule_audit.json lines 30/54 plus the original first BeginStep in the Stage 1 manifest. S4-R1-05: collaborator_check.py environment() now records sys.version, sys.executable and path+sha256 for psana, psana.dgram, psana.detector.jungfrau and psana.detector.UtilsJungfrau; it is printed before any data access and stored under 'runtime' in the success record, and README instructs that a 'Calibrated sample differs' failure under another build is inconclusive and should be returned with the environment output. collaborator_environment_probe.json exercises the collector locally and is labeled as not collaborator acceptance. The only executable change is collaborator_check.py; serial/MPI drivers retain the hashes recorded in the reports (provenance.json vs serial_summary.json code_sha256). unit_checks_followup.txt reports 6 tests OK. The collaborator own-login gate remains open and Stage 4 is not marked complete. One new low, non-blocking finding: the handoff command points at an archived copy of collaborator_check.py whose equality to the revised committed script is not evidenced in the repository.
